//: Skip Vercel preview builds for Dependabot branches. Their previews add no value (GitHub Actions CI validates every PR) and fail on things unrelated to our code — TypeScript 7 breaking Next's config loader, pnpm's minimum-release-age guard on freshly published versions. Exit 0 = skip build, exit 1 = build. main and any human branch still build normally.
ignoreCommand: if echo "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" | grep -q '^dependabot/'; then exit 0; else exit 1; fi
